claim: `tprod_nonneg` carries an unnecessary `[L.NeBot]` hypothesis, so it is stated in less generality than its additive counterpart and its sibling. In the same file, `tsum_nonneg` (the additive counterpart, introduced at line 167 as `@[to_additive tsum_nonneg]` on `one_le_tprod`) has no `[L.NeBot]`, and the multiplicative sibling `one_le_tprod` (lines 167–173) also states its conclusion for every summation filter, disposing of the degenerate case with `tprod_bot`. The nonnegativity statement does not need `L.NeBot`: in the `¬L.NeBot` case `tprod` is `finprod` and nonnegativity follows by induction on the factors.
